Untouched artifacts from the real pinned LibreLane 3.0.16 qualification named in
`provenance.json`. The partial flow stopped after `Checker.YosysSynthChecks`.
Both synthesis and final checker states report mapped area 5245.0304 µm²,
488 cells, zero unmapped cells, and zero synthesis check errors. All configured
TECH_LEF corners define the same `unithd` placement site. Original bytes, PDK
headers, paths, image identity and SHA256s are retained.

These are technology-mapped synthesis measurements, not final routed area,
timing, signoff or Tiny Tapeout compatibility. The later sizing calculation is
explicitly an estimate. The fixture contains no design RTL, testbench or hidden
reference source. The qualification used public generated material; no design
behavior was inspected to implement these general parsers.

Unit transport controls replay these artifact formats in isolation. They do not
qualify the fixture's measured area for the unrelated handwritten unit source.
